mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 1.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points indicates accelerating inflation, triggering preemptive monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5pp MoM, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and non-farm payrolls indicate labor market overheating followed by rapid cooling, signaling imminent economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when both UNRATE and PAYEMS decline, or interaction effect p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Residential construction permits (HOUST) exceeding 1500 thousand units signal strong housing market momentum, driving consumer spending growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when HOUST > 1500, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100 index points indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output capacity and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in consumer spending (RSAFS) and GDP (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when both RSAFS and GDPC1 rise, or interaction effect p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% combined with declining non-farm payrolls signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending confidence and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0 and PAYEMS declines, or interaction effect p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) combined with low policy rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) indicates accommodative policy amid persistent inflation, signaling future rate hikes and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and FEDFUNDS < 1.5, or interaction effect p-value > 0.05.
